per_key.analysis: Natural calm impersonal reachability status, reusing existing «No se puede contactar con». The remote computer remains the subject of the status; {device} occurs exactly once and is opaque, without gender/article rewriting. No phone error implied.

Natural infinitive section heading, not an imperative or progress claim. Mover and copiar exactly match existing row_long_press_hint; a introduces the destination choices. Sentence case and no punctuation match context. One extra codepoint is not material expansion.

per_key.english: This app can offer the devices your sessions show. A device with no visible session cannot be picked yet — open Local Operator on the other computer and pull the list to refresh.
per_key.current_text: Esta app solo ofrece los dispositivos que aparecen en tus sesiones. Si un dispositivo no tiene ninguna sesión visible, aún no puedes seleccionarlo. Abre Local Operator en el otro equipo y desliza la lista hacia abajo para actualizarla.
per_key.analysis: Idiomatic professional tú register: tus, puedes, Abre, desliza match existing Comprueba/Actualiza. Restricts offers to devices visible through sessions, retains aún and both steps in order: open Local Operator on the other equipo, then swipe the list downward to refresh. Local Operator unchanged; no claim of network-wide discovery. Dispositivo is generic destination; equipo is computer. App is natural neutral contemporary UI Spanish, not a register defect.

per_key.english: It did not answer when this computer asked.
per_key.current_text: No respondió a la solicitud de este equipo.
per_key.analysis: Idiomatic omitted remote-computer subject; respondió a la solicitud naturally renders the English computer request, avoiding a literal anthropomorphic preguntó. Este equipo remains the requesting relay computer, not the phone. Code inspection confirms this is a client fallback only when trimmed server reason is absent; server reason is not translated.

Natural factual status preserving otros and visibles: it does not say devices are offline or absent from the network. Generic dispositivo remains distinct from computer equipo. Grammatical plural is not ICU count logic.

Natural location fragment En este equipo matches existing equipo conectado/propietario and reused remote-location En {device}. Does not substitute phone or introduce ordenador/máquina. No punctuation.

Ahora mismo is an idiomatic current-state section label in this position, not a command to act immediately. Existing sidebar also uses ahora mismo; sentence case and no punctuation match the compact heading.
